scripts.setup: bun scripts/configure.ts && bun --cwd apps/server db:generate && bun --cwd apps/server db:migrate
scripts.build:web: bun scripts/icons.ts && bun run typecheck:web && bun --cwd apps/web build
scripts.build:server: bun --cwd apps/server db:generate && bun --cwd apps/server build
